what: gold-support-supervised evidence-sufficiency classifier (Sufficient-Context family) replayed as a stopping rule
not_a_reproduction: This is NOT HALT and NOT a reproduction of any released sufficiency verifier; no released verifier weights were run.
supervision: gold support-sentence coverage at each retrieval prefix, threshold 0.80 token recall, fixed a priori

test_time_signals.lex12: those nine plus three offline lexical evidence features; gold support is never read at test time

selection: tau on that cell's own training chains only, frozen band rule, 5-fold cross-fitting by chain (seed 3)
